title: SI.gov | America's Super Intelligence Initiatives
excerpt: Explore President Trump's Super Intelligence initiatives, from the Genesis Mission to SI Education and the Presidential SI Challenge.
content_html:
America is in a racefor Super Intelligence.We intend to win it.

The official home of America's work to lead the world in Super Intelligence, from the Genesis Mission to the next generation of American innovators.

Explore Initiatives

Why it matters

Whoever builds the largest SI ecosystem will set the global standards and reap the economic and security rewards.

Under President Trump, the nation aims to usher in a new golden age of innovation, human flourishing and technological achievement for the American people.

Presidential action

0

executive orders on Super Intelligence across President Trump’s two terms.

From clearing barriers in January 2025 to frontier security in 2026. Scroll on for three orders reshaping the country.

November 24, 2025

The Genesis Mission

The nation's flagship SI-for-Science initiative that unites 15 federal agencies with industry, academia, and the Department of Energy's National Labs to solve the most pressing challenges using super intelligence.

July 23, 2025

Data Center Infrastructure

Federal permitting for the data centers that power Super Intelligence moves faster, so American capacity can be built on American soil.

July 23, 2025

The American SI Stack

America exports its full technology stack, from chips to models to standards, to allies and partners around the world.

Watch

Science: A NewGolden Age Summit

A look into the historic gathering to renew American Science for a New Golden Age of Discovery.

Initiatives

Raising the nextgeneration ofAmerican innovators.

“The United Statesof America is theLeader in SI”

President Donald J. Trump

Follow every SI initiative as it happens.
